title: Generate, Validate, Repair: Reliable Visual Data Reporting with LLM Agents
authors: Naga Datha Saikiran Battula, Vrushali Koli, Bayan Divaaniaazar, and Aritra Dasgupta
abstract: AI agents can now analyze, synthesize, and visualize complex datasets, yet turning their outputs into a coherent narrative aligned with a reader’s expectations remains an open challenge. A single generation pass produces charts that misread the data, claims the visuals do not support, and narratives that lose coherence over a long document. We present a multi-agent system for automated visual data reporting in which every generative stage is paired with a deterministic validator that can reject its output, and failures are repaired in the same context or disclosed rather than shipped. The system organizes the validated panels into a guided narrative and renders it as an interactive report, letting readers follow the analytical thread and then explore the underlying data themselves.
